description: Source code for BN_CTX management in OpenSSL, implementing functions for context creation, initialization, allocation, and cleanup of big number (BIGNUM) resources.

methods.name: BN_CTX_new
methods.description: Creates and allocates a new BN_CTX structure, initializing it and setting the malloced flag.

methods.name: BN_CTX_init
methods.description: Initializes a BN_CTX structure, setting up internal counters and arrays.

methods.name: BN_CTX_free
methods.description: Frees the BN_CTX structure and its internal BIGNUMs if allocated dynamically.

methods.name: BN_CTX_start
methods.description: Marks the start of a new temporary BIGNUM allocation scope within the context.

methods.name: BN_CTX_get
methods.description: Retrieves a BIGNUM from the context, managing internal stack and error state.

methods.name: BN_CTX_end
methods.description: Ends a temporary BIGNUM allocation scope, restoring internal state.
